integrity: Proof is self-contained; exact symbolic small-case checks and rational diagnostics in check.py are corroborative, not substitutes for the unrestricted fixed-space proof. One relevant 2016 full text was inaccessible after checking accessible primary versions.
scientific_limitations: Sharp variation norm explicitly computed at four points only; all larger second-difference sample lengths have a proved strict lower bound above one without a closed norm formula. Unweighted real finite uniform-grid data; no weighted or non-symmetric generalization claimed.
title: A four-sample total-variation instability threshold for Whittaker smoothing
